title: Fixes AB#640874: Clarify Expense Agent scheduling permission error
summary: The Expense Agent scheduler authorization error message is now clearer, providing specific guidance to users about missing permissions and directing them to request 'Can Configure Agent' access from an administrator.
key_points: Error message is more descriptive and actionable
Includes localized field and page captions as placeholders
Maintains existing rejection behavior for both missing access and missing Can Configure Agent permissions
No changes to authorization, scheduling, or permissions logic
Message is consistently applied across wizard and scheduler paths
quote: Replace the ambiguous Expense Agent scheduler authorization error with actionable guidance
